in_marathi.name: Devavani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devavani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Devavani is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ meaning god and ‘Vani’ meaning voice. It is the name of a goddess or the divine voice of a deity. The name is also associated with the river Devana, which is believed to be the voice of the goddess Devi.
